'''Vermilion''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who was active during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
In [[3640 BBY]], he was hired by the Empire to hunt down and eliminate Selonians that served in the resistance during the [[Battle of Corellia|battle]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. He deployed specially-programmed war droids that are designed to target any Selonian in the area of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]]. When [[Lachei]] was able to locate the droids' command unit in the tunnels below the shipyards, Vermilion and his unit engaged a Republic strike team who were able to defeat him and end the threat.
